name: Athletic Pubalgia / Core Muscle Injury
definition: Activity-related groin pain involving the lower abdominal wall, adductor-aponeurotic complex or pubic region without a classic inguinal hernia.

typical: Pain with sit-up or resisted adduction

investigations.principle: MRI pelvis can help define rectus-adductor aponeurotic injury and exclude mimics in persistent cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, tendon, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Surgery is selective for persistent well-localized symptoms after structured rehabilitation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Activity-related groin pain involving the lower abdominal wall, adductor-aponeurotic complex or pubic region without a classic inguinal hernia.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
